# 5-Day Vegetarian Meal Plan for 2 Adults

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

A budget-conscious plan built for **one gluten-free eater**, **weekday meals in 30 minutes or less**, and **batch-cook leftovers**. I assumed pantry basics like salt, pepper, oil, and common dried spices are already on hand.

## 5-Day Menu with Leftovers in Mind

| Day | Meal | Time | Gluten-Free Notes | Batch-Cook Angle |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Lentil taco bowls | 25 min | Naturally GF | Make extra lentils for Day 2 |
| 2 | Lentil stuffed peppers | 30 min | Naturally GF | Uses leftover lentils |
| 3 | Chickpea spinach curry + rice | 25 min | Serve with rice | Make extra for Day 4 lunch/dinner |
| 4 | Veggie fried rice with tofu | 20 min | Use tamari, not soy sauce | Best with leftover rice |
| 5 | Sheet-pan roasted vegetables + polenta | 30 min | Naturally GF | Roast extra vegetables for lunches |

## Grocery List by Aisle

### Produce
- 2 onions
- 1 bulb garlic
- 3 bell peppers
- 2 zucchini
- 1 bag carrots
- 1 head broccoli
- 1 bag spinach
- 2 sweet potatoes
- 2 lemons
- 1 bunch cilantro or parsley
- 1 avocado, optional
- 1 cucumber, optional for side salads

### Canned / Jarred
- 2 cans black beans
- 2 cans chickpeas
- 2 cans diced tomatoes
- 1 small can tomato paste
- 1 jar salsa
- 1 carton vegetable broth

### Dry Goods / Grains
- Brown rice, 2 lb bag
- Gluten-free oats or corn tortillas, 1 pack
- Quinoa or polenta, 1 box/bag
- Rice noodles or extra rice, optional if budget allows
- Lentils, 1 lb
- GF tamari or certified gluten-free soy sauce

### Refrigerated / Dairy
- 1 block tofu
- 1 dozen eggs, optional for extra protein
- Shredded cheese or plain yogurt, optional
- Butter or margarine, optional

### Frozen
- 1 bag frozen corn
- 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables

### Spices / Pantry Check
- Cumin
- Chili powder
- Curry powder
- Italian seasoning
- Paprika
- Salt and pepper
- Olive oil or cooking oil

## Meal-by-Meal Prep Instructions

### Day 1: Lentil Taco Bowls
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/basket.svg
- Cook lentils with onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder, and diced tomatoes.
- Warm black beans and corn in a skillet or microwave.
- Serve over rice with salsa and optional avocado.
- Make 2 extra servings for Day 2.

### Day 2: Lentil Stuffed Peppers
- Halve bell peppers and roast cut-side up for 10 minutes.
- Mix leftover lentils with rice, tomato paste, and seasoning.
- Fill peppers, top with cheese if using, and bake until hot.
- Add a simple cucumber side salad if desired.

### Day 3: Chickpea Spinach Curry + Rice
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/egg-fried.svg
- Sauté onion and garlic, then add curry powder and chickpeas.
- Stir in diced tomatoes, a splash of broth, and spinach.
- Simmer 10 minutes and serve over rice.
- Double the batch for Day 4 leftovers if you want an easier night.

### Day 4: Veggie Fried Rice with Tofu
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/box-seam.svg
- Use cold leftover rice for best texture.
- Pan-fry tofu cubes until golden, then add frozen vegetables.
- Stir in rice, tamari, and a little oil; cook until heated through.
- Add scrambled egg if you want extra protein and have room in budget.

### Day 5: Sheet-Pan Roasted Vegetables + Polenta
- Roast carrots, zucchini, broccoli, and sweet potatoes with oil and seasoning.
- While they roast, cook polenta on the stove with water or broth.
- Serve vegetables over polenta with lemon juice.
- Save leftovers for lunch bowls.

## Budget Snapshot

- Lentils, beans, chickpeas, rice, and frozen vegetables keep cost low.
- Estimated total: **about $68–$75**, depending on store and whether you buy optional items like cheese, eggs, or avocado.
- If you need to trim cost further, skip avocado, cheese, and extra snacks first.
